_comment: Crew needs and health rules. All numbers are placeholders for game balance, NOT real NASA data.

base_power_per_sol.note: Heaters, air fans and computers. Always powered first.

radiation_limit.note: Game exposure limit in made-up 'dose points', not millisieverts.

stress_per_sol.note: Isolation and hard work. Habitats cancel it out.

cold_penalty.note: Lost when base power cannot be met.

crowding_penalty.note: Lost per crew member without a habitat bed.

radiation_sickness_threshold.note: Daily dose above this hurts health.

low_supply_threshold.note: Fraction of storage. Below this the crew rations and worries.
